image_description: A close-up portrait of a Brown Pelican (Pelecanus occidentalis) floating on water. The bird features a white head with yellowish crown, a long dark bill, and a prominent gular pouch. The body plumage is a mix of brown and grey scales, with darker flight feathers visible on the folded wing. The background is blurred blue-grey water.
